### Headline summary
- Nvidia reported record revenue and established a security committee while halting H200 chip sales to China. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/nvidia-promises-that-revenue-will-keep-soaring-for-now/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-18/nvidia-boosts-forecast-quashes-huang-s-return-video), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261117/p63#a261117p63), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-18/interim-nvidia-ceo-says-it-s-no-longer-sending-ai-chips-to-china))
- Anthropic is finalizing its IPO with a price set above its preliminary range, drawing scrutiny over its safety branding. ([Latest from Sifted](https://sifted.eu/articles/anthropic-ipo-puts-europe-ai-boom-to-the-test/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-anthropic-price-ipo-key-ai.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261118/p30#a261118p30), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261118974464/en/Anthropic-is-Not-a-Safe-AI-Company---Broad-Coalition-of-Scientists-Legal-Scholars-and-Tech-Leaders-Challenge-Anthropics-Safety-Branding-Ahead-of-IPO))
- OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models, while Microsoft made Office apps generally available in Copilot. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-openai-gpt-6-2-astra-pricing-reliability/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/18/openai-releases-gpt-6-2-astra-and-sol-with-lower-api-prices-and-ultrafast-for-pro-200/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/11/microsoft-calls-copilot-the-new-os-for-work-at-ignite-keynote/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/microsoft-makes-office-and-home-generally-available-in-copilot/))

### Nvidia reports record revenue and establishes security committee
Nvidia reported record revenue and confirmed that CEO Jensen Huang will not return to the role, while also establishing a new security committee. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/nvidia-promises-that-revenue-will-keep-soaring-for-now/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-18/nvidia-boosts-forecast-quashes-huang-s-return-video), [Gizmodo](https://gizmodo.com/what-does-nvidia-have-to-say-about-jensen-huang-dont-ask-2000841459), [Datafloq](https://datafloq.com/nvidias-first-earnings-report-after-huang-115-8b-in-revenue-and-a-succession-question-investors-cant-price/))

### Anthropic sets IPO pricing above market range
Anthropic is finalizing its initial public offering with a price set well above its preliminary range of $70 to $78 per share, with reports suggesting a price above $80. The company is also considering increasing the size of the IPO due to high investor demand. ([Latest from Sifted](https://sifted.eu/articles/anthropic-ipo-puts-europe-ai-boom-to-the-test/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-anthropic-price-ipo-key-ai.html), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-18/anthropic-said-to-guide-ipo-pricing-above-market-range-video), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/400b-in-institutional-interest-has-anthropic-considering-an-ipo-raise/))

### Nvidia halts H200 chip sales to China
Nvidia announced it will no longer sell H200 chips to China, ending a deal that had allowed sales under US government approval. The decision was made by interim CEO Colette Kress and reported by multiple outlets. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261117/p63#a261117p63), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-18/interim-nvidia-ceo-says-it-s-no-longer-sending-ai-chips-to-china), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/nvidia-ends-h200-chip-sales-in-china-amid-tighter-export-rules/), [Gizmodo](https://gizmodo.com/nvidia-stops-shipping-h200s-to-customers-in-china-2000841474))

### OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models
OpenAI has released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, new models featuring lower API prices and improved performance in testing. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-openai-gpt-6-2-astra-pricing-reliability/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/18/openai-releases-gpt-6-2-astra-and-sol-with-lower-api-prices-and-ultrafast-for-pro-200/))

### Microsoft makes Office apps generally available in Copilot
Microsoft announced that Word, Excel, and PowerPoint are now generally available inside Copilot, which CEO Satya Nadella described as the new operating system for work. The announcement was made at the Ignite 2026 event. ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/11/microsoft-calls-copilot-the-new-os-for-work-at-ignite-keynote/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/microsoft-makes-office-and-home-generally-available-in-copilot/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261118/p1#a261118p1))

### Investigation into cause of massive tech service outages
US officials and executives told Congress that recent massive tech outages were caused by systems overwhelmed by a rush to patch vulnerabilities found by AI models, while the Secretary of State stated there was no evidence the outages were linked to a single coordinated event. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261117/p66#a261117p66), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/zero-evidence-recent-tech-outages-linked-marco-rubio), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/banks-nsa-admit-ai-massive-outages), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/jay-clayton-ai-tech-outages-infrastructure))

### Coalition signs statement challenging Anthropic's safety branding
The Center for AI Safety and other groups signed the MisAnthropic Statement, challenging Anthropic's safety branding and its approach to building recursive self-improvement ahead of its IPO. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261118/p30#a261118p30), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261118974464/en/Anthropic-is-Not-a-Safe-AI-Company---Broad-Coalition-of-Scientists-Legal-Scholars-and-Tech-Leaders-Challenge-Anthropics-Safety-Branding-Ahead-of-IPO))

### ByteDance in talks to spend $500M on Microsoft Azure
ByteDance is in advanced talks to spend an additional $500 million on Microsoft Azure cloud services, primarily to access OpenAI models. The deal has reportedly drawn complaints from OpenAI. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/microsoft-nears-500-million-deal-sell-ai-bytedance-irking-openai), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261118/p21#a261118p21))
